TEST: Load Image (Filename) -> Save Image.

The filename output feeds Save Image's filename_prefix, so the saved file's name IS the node's sanitized output. Pick an input whose name contains a newline, ':' or '/' (upload one, e.g. a file named 'weird:emoji🔥.png').

Toggle matrix to validate:
- sanitize ON,  emoji ON  -> control chars, : / \ " <> | * and emoji all removed; leading/trailing . and spaces trimmed.
- sanitize ON,  emoji OFF -> control/path/reserved chars removed, emoji kept.
- sanitize OFF, emoji OFF -> raw file name, untouched.

Each toggle is part of IS_CHANGED, so flipping a toggle re-runs the node (output filename updates without changing the seed).
